layout_description: Printed (typed, condensed caps font) landscape sheet, scanned rotated 90deg. Title 'KT INSTALLATION SCHEDULE'; date written vertically along left edge in a shaded band ('THURSDAY, OCTOBER 29, 2026'). Four crew columns per page; column header = lead name on line 1, helper(s) on line 2 (slash-separated when 2 helpers, e.g. 'OSCAR C / IVAN T'). Below header, a grid of up to ~5 stop blocks per column, each block = 1 blank top row (used for start time, e.g. handwritten '7:00') + 3 shaded rows: CUSTOMER/builder, JOB name (or street address / bldg), CITY. No row labels, no lot counts, no product, no work type on the sheet. Continues on page 2 (no repeated title/date) with 4 more crews, so 8 crews total on 2 pages.
observations: Only stop #1 filled for most crews; a few crews get a 2nd stop block. Schedule city can disagree with WO (Encino vs Van Nuys).

layout_description: Printed landscape sheet (scanned rotated). Title 'DAILY STOCKING SHEET', 'STOCKING ON: <day, date>'. Row labels on the left: (header = lead), STOCKER x2 rows (helpers), TIME IN, BUILDER, JOB, CITY, TIME OUT, blank row; then a second identical block (TIME IN, BUILDER, JOB, CITY, TIME OUT, blank) for stop 2. 3 crew columns. A 3rd helper overflows into the TIME IN row (Jesus Aceves). Dispatcher annotates in purple pen: check-in times and 'done'.
observations: Hydroflow Fire Pro / Slauson Ave LA stops (pages 3,5) are NOT on the schedule -- both MG crews were redirected after cancellation. 'ES' meaning unclear (product line? 'estaquear'?). Typo DISCVOVERY in printed sheet.
